name: submit_image
description:
Submit an image generation job and create image asset(s) in the project library. Requires ChatCut Pro and consumes credits for every model. This tool does not place generated images on the timeline; after the job completes, use track_progress to get asset ids and edit_item to place them. See the image-gen skill for model, reference, aspect-ratio, and quality guidance.

If confirmation times out or is cancelled before the user answers, ask the user to retry.

aspectRatio.description: Output aspect ratio. Defaults to 16:9. If the project composition is not 16:9, ask the user before generating.

background.description: Image 2.5 only. Use transparent for a PNG cutout; defaults to auto.

count.description: Number of images to generate. Each becomes a separate job.

imageSize.description: Output size. Defaults to 1K. Only pass 2K or 4K when the user explicitly asks — they're EXPERIMENTAL and slower.

model.description: Image model. Defaults to gpt-image-2.5-flare for everyday generation and edits. gpt-image-2.5-sunburst for precision editing; gpt-image-2 remains available; nano-banana supports up to 14 references. Honor the image model attached to the prompt.

name.description: Asset name shown in the library. Defaults to a truncated form of the prompt.

prompt.description: Description of the image. Mention text content in quotes when text rendering is needed.

quality.description: OpenAI models only. Defaults to high. xhigh and max require Image 2.5.

referenceAssetIds.description: Project asset ids to reference. Pass when the user @-references an image asset; the backend resolves bytes server-side.
